```{r setup, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(3459)
setwd("~/projects/thesis_scripts/figure_scripts/water_pay/")
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(patchwork)
library(svglite)
library(viridis)
library(colorspace)
library(broom)

source("../../src/neuron_smoothing.R")
source("../../src/figs.R")

monkey_fill_pal <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("royalblue", "darkorange"), labels = c("Monkey U", "Monkey V"), guide = FALSE)
monkey_col_pal <- scale_colour_manual(values = c("royalblue", "darkorange"), labels = c("Monkey U", "Monkey V"), guide = FALSE)

neuronal_data <- bind_rows(
  readRDS("../../data/neurons/onefrac_noerror_neuronal_data.rds"),
  readRDS("../../data/neurons/threefrac_noerror_neuronal_data.rds"),
)
task_data <- readRDS("../../data/neurons/task_data.rds")

cell_baselines_fractals <-
  readRDS("../../data/baseline/cell_prefc_baselines_fractals_smoothed.rds")
cell_baselines_fractal_counts <-
  readRDS("../../data/baseline/cell_prefc_baselines_fractals.rds")
cell_baselines_counts <-
  readRDS("../../data/baseline/cell_prefc_baselines.rds")

sigcells_uly <-
  read_csv("../../data/cells/uly_sig_cells.csv") %>%
  mutate(monkey = "Monkey U") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, "%d-%b-%y"))
sigcells_vice <-
  read_csv("../../data/cells/vice_sig_cells.csv") %>%
  mutate(monkey = "Monkey V") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, "%d-%b-%Y"))

sigcells <-
  bind_rows(sigcells_uly, sigcells_vice) %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0("cell", gsub("^(Clust)([0-9])(_.*)$", "\\2", cluster)))

monkey_windows <- read_csv("../../data/config/monkey_windows.csv") %>%
  mutate(window_start = c(180, 160), window_end = c(340, 350))
configs <- read_csv("../../data/config/configs.csv")

group_cols <- c("date", "monkey", "cell")
group_cols_fractal <- c(group_cols, "fractal_value")

relevant_cells <- sigcells %>%
  select(date, monkey, cell, isDA, isResponsive, numTrGood, DAFracResponsive) %>%
  filter(isDA == 1 & isResponsive == 1 & numTrGood == 1) %>%
  distinct(date, monkey, cell, .keep_all = TRUE)

n_start <- filter(configs, var == "neurons_start") %>% pull(value)
n_end <- filter(configs, var == "neurons_end") %>% pull(value)
smooth_window <-
  filter(configs, var == "smooth_window") %>% pull(value)
```

```{r monkey_bid_baselines}
pre_start <- -400
pre_end <- -50

water_task_data <- task_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(error_bit, ~ is.na(unlist(.x)))) %>%
  select(date, monkey, trial, fractal_value, monkey_bid, computer_bid) %>%
  distinct(date, monkey, trial, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(monkey_bid != computer_bid) %>%
  mutate(
    monkey_win = monkey_bid > computer_bid, 
    budget_remaining = case_when(
      monkey_win ~ 100 - computer_bid
    )
  )

water_data <- neuronal_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(bits, function(x) {
    if (!is.null(x) && is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) > 0) {
      matching_rows <- x$names == "budget_epoch_end" & x$index == "upat"
      sum(matching_rows) == 1 && !is.na(x$vals[matching_rows])
    } else {
      FALSE
    }
  }))  %>%
  unnest(bits) %>%
  filter(names == "budget_epoch_end" & index == "upat") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = names, values_from = vals)

water_spikes <- water_data %>%
  inner_join(water_task_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "trial")) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - budget_epoch_end) %>%
  select(date, monkey, trial, cell, spike_bit_time_ms, fractal_value, monkey_win, budget_remaining)

water_baselines <- water_spikes %>%
  filter(spike_bit_time_ms >= pre_start & spike_bit_time_ms <= pre_end) %>%
  select(date, monkey, cell, monkey_win, spike_bit_time_ms) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, monkey_win) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_df(get_baseline_params, w = smooth_window, t = pre_start:pre_end)

water_smoothed <- water_spikes %>%
  filter(spike_bit_time_ms >= n_start &
           spike_bit_time_ms <= n_end) %>%
  inner_join(relevant_cells, by = group_cols) %>%
  select(date, monkey, cell, monkey_win, spike_bit_time_ms) %>%
  nest(vector = spike_bit_time_ms) %>%
  left_join(water_baselines, by = c(group_cols, "monkey_win")) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c(
    group_cols, "monkey_win"
  )))) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_df(smooth_data, start = n_start, end = n_end, 100) %>%
  group_by(monkey, t, monkey_win) %>%
  summarise(
    av_zscore = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_zscore = sd(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "keep"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sem = sd_zscore / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    trial_outcome = case_when(
      monkey_win ~ "monkey wins auction",
      TRUE ~ "monkey loses auction"
    )
  )

p_water <-
  ggplot(
    water_smoothed %>% filter(
      t > filter(configs, var == "fig_start") %>% pull(value) &
        t < filter(configs, var == "fig_end") %>% pull(value)
    ),
    aes(x = t, y = av_zscore, colour = trial_outcome)
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = monkey_windows,
    aes(
      xmin = window_start,
      xmax = window_end,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    fill = "grey",
    alpha = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "purple"),
                      name = "trial outcome") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_wrap(~ monkey, scales = "free") +
  population_firing_fig_theme(
    filter(configs, var == "fig_start") %>% pull(value),
    filter(configs, var == "fig_end") %>% pull(value),
    "budget payout"
  )


```

```{r linear_model, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
ntiles = 25

win_water_data <- task_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  filter(monkey_bid > computer_bid) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, fractal_value, monkey_bid, computer_bid) %>%
  mutate(
    monkey_win = monkey_bid > computer_bid,
    budget_remaining = 100- computer_bid,
    budget_profit = monkey_bid - computer_bid,
    budget_remaining_ntile = cut(
      budget_remaining,
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 100/ntiles),
      labels = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    budget_profit_ntile = cut(
      budget_profit,
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 100/ntiles),
      labels = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
  )

water_budget_data <- win_water_data %>%
  group_by(monkey, monkey_win, budget_remaining_ntile) %>%
  filter(n() > 20)

budget_relevant_cells_ntiles <- merge(
  sigcells,
  water_budget_data %>% select(monkey, monkey_win, budget_remaining_ntile) %>% distinct(),
  by = "monkey",
  all = TRUE
)

water_budget_spikes <- water_data %>%
  inner_join(water_budget_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "session", "trial")) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, budget_remaining_ntile, budget_epoch_end, sorted_spikes) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - budget_epoch_end) 

water_budget_spikes_ntiles <- water_budget_spikes %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, session, trial, budget_remaining_ntile) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= 0 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 500), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(budget_relevant_cells_ntiles, by = c(group_cols, "budget_remaining_ntile")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n ,0)) 

baselines <- cell_baselines_counts %>%
  inner_join(relevant_cells, by = group_cols) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, trial) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= -500 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(adj_n = n) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell) %>%
  summarise(mean_n = mean(adj_n), sd_n = sd(adj_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(sd_n != 0)

water_budget_normalised_spikes <- water_budget_spikes_ntiles %>%
  left_join(baselines, by = group_cols) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(norm_n = (n - mean_n) / sd_n) %>%
  group_by(monkey, budget_remaining_ntile) %>%
  summarise(mean_n_s = mean(norm_n), sem = sd(norm_n) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(budget_perc = budget_remaining_ntile / ntiles) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sem))

p_budget_remaining <- ggplot(water_budget_normalised_spikes, aes(x = budget_perc, y = mean_n_s, colour = monkey, group = monkey)) + 
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_n_s - sem, ymax = mean_n_s + sem), width = 0) +
  monkey_col_pal +
  labs(
    x = "budget remaining percentage",
    y = "normalised firing rate (impulses/s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ monkey, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r}
water_profit_data <- win_water_data %>%
  group_by(monkey, monkey_win, budget_profit_ntile) %>%
  filter(n() > 30)

profit_relevant_cells_ntiles <- merge(
  sigcells,
  water_profit_data %>% select(monkey, monkey_win, budget_profit_ntile) %>% distinct(),
  by = "monkey",
  all = TRUE
)

water_profit_spikes <- water_data %>%
  inner_join(water_profit_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "session", "trial")) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, budget_profit_ntile, budget_epoch_end, sorted_spikes) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - budget_epoch_end) 

water_budget_spikes_ntiles <- water_profit_spikes %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, session, trial, budget_profit_ntile) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= 0 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 500), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(profit_relevant_cells_ntiles, by = c(group_cols, "budget_profit_ntile")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n ,0)) 

water_profit_normalised_spikes <- water_budget_spikes_ntiles %>%
  left_join(baselines, by = group_cols) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(norm_n = (n - mean_n) / sd_n) %>%
  group_by(monkey, budget_profit_ntile) %>%
  summarise(mean_n_s = mean(norm_n), sem = sd(norm_n) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(profit_perc = budget_profit_ntile / ntiles) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sem))

p_profit <- ggplot(water_profit_normalised_spikes, aes(x = profit_perc, y = mean_n_s, colour = monkey, group = monkey)) + 
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_n_s - sem, ymax = mean_n_s + sem), width = 0) +
  monkey_col_pal +
  labs(
    x = "budget profit percentage",
    y = "normalised firing rate (impulses/s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ monkey, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r stats}
monkey_u_budget <- water_budget_normalised_spikes %>% 
  filter(monkey == "Monkey U")
monkey_u_profit <- water_profit_normalised_spikes %>% 
  filter(monkey == "Monkey U")
monkey_v_budget <- water_budget_normalised_spikes %>% 
  filter(monkey == "Monkey V")
monkey_v_profit <- water_profit_normalised_spikes %>% 
  filter(monkey == "Monkey V")

model_u_budget <- lm(mean_n_s ~ budget_perc, data = monkey_u_budget)
model_u_profit <- lm(mean_n_s ~ profit_perc, data = monkey_u_profit)
model_v_budget <- lm(mean_n_s ~ budget_perc, data = monkey_v_budget)
model_v_profit <- lm(mean_n_s ~ profit_perc, data = monkey_v_profit)

coef_u_budget <- tidy(model_u_budget)
coef_u_profit <- tidy(model_u_profit)
coef_v_budget <- tidy(model_v_budget)
coef_v_profit <- tidy(model_v_profit)

glance_u_budget <- glance(model_u_budget)
glance_u_profit <- glance(model_u_profit)
glance_v_budget <- glance(model_v_budget)
glance_v_profit <- glance(model_v_profit)

# Function to format estimate ± std.error
format_estimate <- function(estimate, std.error, digits = 4) {
  sprintf("%.4f ± %.4f", estimate, std.error)
}

# Create comprehensive results table
results_table <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    monkey = "Monkey U",
    outcome = "budget",
    intercept = format_estimate(
      coef_u_budget$estimate[coef_u_budget$term == "(Intercept)"],
      coef_u_budget$std.error[coef_u_budget$term == "(Intercept)"]
    ),
    slope = format_estimate(
      coef_u_budget$estimate[coef_u_budget$term == "budget_perc"],
      coef_u_budget$std.error[coef_u_budget$term == "budget_perc"]
    ),
    slope_p = coef_u_budget$p.value[coef_u_budget$term == "budget_perc"],
    adj_r_squared = glance_u_budget$adj.r.squared
  ),
  data.frame(
    monkey = "Monkey U",
    outcome = "profit",
    intercept = format_estimate(
      coef_u_profit$estimate[coef_u_profit$term == "(Intercept)"],
      coef_u_profit$std.error[coef_u_profit$term == "(Intercept)"]
    ),
    slope = format_estimate(
      coef_u_profit$estimate[coef_u_profit$term == "profit_perc"],
      coef_u_profit$std.error[coef_u_profit$term == "profit_perc"]
    ),
    slope_p = coef_u_profit$p.value[coef_u_profit$term == "profit_perc"],
    adj_r_squared = glance_u_profit$adj.r.squared
  ),
  data.frame(
    monkey = "Monkey V",
    outcome = "budget",
    intercept = format_estimate(
      coef_v_budget$estimate[coef_v_budget$term == "(Intercept)"],
      coef_v_budget$std.error[coef_v_budget$term == "(Intercept)"]
    ),
    slope = format_estimate(
      coef_v_budget$estimate[coef_v_budget$term == "budget_perc"],
      coef_v_budget$std.error[coef_v_budget$term == "budget_perc"]
    ),
    slope_p = coef_v_budget$p.value[coef_v_budget$term == "budget_perc"],
    adj_r_squared = glance_v_budget$adj.r.squared
  ),
  data.frame(
    monkey = "Monkey V",
    outcome = "profit",
    intercept = format_estimate(
      coef_v_profit$estimate[coef_v_profit$term == "(Intercept)"],
      coef_v_profit$std.error[coef_v_profit$term == "(Intercept)"]
    ),
    slope = format_estimate(
      coef_v_profit$estimate[coef_v_profit$term == "profit_perc"],
      coef_v_profit$std.error[coef_v_profit$term == "profit_perc"]
    ),
    slope_p = coef_v_profit$p.value[coef_v_profit$term == "profit_perc"],
    adj_r_squared = glance_v_profit$adj.r.squared
  )
)

print(results_table)
```
```{r}
water_spikes_full <- water_data %>%
  inner_join(win_water_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "session", "trial")) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, budget_remaining, budget_profit, budget_epoch_end, sorted_spikes) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - budget_epoch_end)

water_spikes_trial <- water_spikes_full %>%
  inner_join(relevant_cells %>% select(all_of(group_cols)), by = group_cols) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, session, trial, budget_remaining, budget_profit) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= 0 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 500), .groups = "drop")

water_trial_level <- water_spikes_trial %>%
  left_join(baselines, by = group_cols) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    norm_n = (n - mean_n) / sd_n,
    budget_remaining_perc = budget_remaining / 100,
    budget_profit_perc = budget_profit / 100,
    cell_id = paste(date, monkey, cell, sep = "_")
  )

me_results_water_remaining <- water_trial_level %>%
  group_by(monkey) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lmer(norm_n ~ budget_remaining_perc + (1|cell_id), data = .x, REML = FALSE)
    ct <- coef(summary(m))
    tibble(
      intercept    = ct["(Intercept)", "Estimate"],
      intercept_se = ct["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"],
      slope        = ct["budget_remaining_perc", "Estimate"],
      slope_se     = ct["budget_remaining_perc", "Std. Error"],
      t_value      = ct["budget_remaining_perc", "t value"],
      p_value      = ct["budget_remaining_perc", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  })

me_results_water_profit <- water_trial_level %>%
  group_by(monkey) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lmer(norm_n ~ budget_profit_perc + (1|cell_id), data = .x, REML = FALSE)
    ct <- coef(summary(m))
    tibble(
      intercept    = ct["(Intercept)", "Estimate"],
      intercept_se = ct["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"],
      slope        = ct["budget_profit_perc", "Estimate"],
      slope_se     = ct["budget_profit_perc", "Std. Error"],
      t_value      = ct["budget_profit_perc", "t value"],
      p_value      = ct["budget_profit_perc", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  })

print(me_results_water_remaining)
print(me_results_water_profit)

```
